lockedAlert.title: Booking engine is not enabled
lockedAlert.description: Booking is switched off for your organization, so no offers, reminders or confirmations are sent. Contact your ShowFlow administrator to enable it.

offAlert.title: Booking flow is off
offAlert.description: No new offers open, and no reminders, digests or confirmations are sent. Offers already sent still run out their response window. Pick a flow above to turn it on.

templatesError.title: Booking templates could not be loaded

fromAddress.label: From address (Resend)
fromAddress.helper: Overrides the default sender address for all outgoing emails.

describe.paused: Booking flow paused. No new offers, reminders, digests or confirmations are sent.
describe.directBooking: Artists are booked directly; no offer response is required.
describe.deliveryDigest: offers go out in the {{hour}} digest

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.desc: Via Airtable sync or in-app; either way the date enters the flow here.

openOfferTier.title: Open offer tier
openOfferTier.desc: Creates suggested bookings for every eligible artist in the tier.
openOfferTier.autoOpenLabel: Open tier 1 automatically when a new date is ready
openOfferTier.autoEscalateLabel: Escalate to the next tier automatically when a window closes short
openOfferTier.atRiskLabel: Alert the production team when the open tier cannot fill the remaining primary slots
openOfferTier.atRiskHelper: Checked hourly. An alert is sent when accepted bookings plus live pending offers are fewer than the required primary slots.

notifyArtists.title: Notify artists
notifyArtists.desc: How and when offers reach artists. The response window starts at delivery.
notifyArtists.expiryReminderLabel: Remind artists 24 h before their window closes

artistAcceptance.title: Artist acceptance
artistAcceptance.desc: Artists accept or decline from their calendar. Off means producers book directly, with no offers at all.
artistAcceptance.offNotice: Offers, digests, and response windows are skipped. Producers book from eligibility lists; the artist's first touchpoint is the confirmation.

producerConfirmation.title: Producer confirmation
producerConfirmation.desc: Producer reviews soft-booked artists and confirms the cast. Off means an acceptance confirms immediately.
producerConfirmation.offNotice: With artist acceptance off, the producer's booking is itself the confirmation, so this step can't be skipped.

confirmationDigest.title: Confirmation digest
confirmationDigest.desc: Daily summary email to newly confirmed artists.

understudyPromotion.title: Understudy promotion
understudyPromotion.desc: When a main-cast booking cancels, the longest-waiting accepted understudy is promoted automatically.
